card.name: Inside rheumatology-related words
card.fires_on: The middle piece "umat" or "umatic" in words like rheumatology, rheumatoid and rheumatic. It also fires weakly on a few words after "referred" to a specialist.

modes.label: Rheum- words
modes.description: Fires on the "umat" piece after "Rhe" in rheumatology, rheumatoid or rheumatic.

modes.label: Referral to a specialist
modes.description: Fires on "to" or "a" after "referred" before a specialist is named.
modes.example: you will usually be referred<< to>> a hormone specialist (an endocrinologist
